messages:
maria: Quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

maria: Did: finished SDK auth flow docs + added example for service tokens (PR: #412)

maria: Blockers: sample app build failure on M1 CI — seeing `ld: symbol not found` during link step, unclear if it's a Bazel config or a macOS linker issue :thinking_face:

maria: Today: iterate on quickstart to include token rotation snippet, help Kevin repro the CI link error

kevin: Re: CI — can you paste failing log? I saw something similar, might be from native deps in packaging

maria: Pasted below:
```
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```

kevin: Hmm ok — try `bazel build //sample:app --cpu=darwin_arm64`? I added a patch in my fork that sets correct crosstool

kevin: Also, FYI I opened a small PR to update sample app env var parsing: r: @maria

sam: Did a pass on the quickstart flow — removed the duplicate env var step and added a troubleshooting section for KMS errors

sam: Blocker: waiting on docs-team review of new KMS wording (legal wants specific phrasing)

tara: I'll take the KMS wording review today, tagging legal: @legal-team

maria: Thanks @tara :pray: — if you can approve wording, I'll merge and cut a patch release

leo: Small heads up — console telemetry events changed shape; sample app needs to map old event names. Pushed a migration helper to utils.

maria: Noted; I'll wire the helper into the sample app after CI green

doc-bot: Deploy status — preview site for PR #412 built successfully at https://deploy.preview/412 :rocket:

kevin: Quick question — should quickstarts keep both `curl` and `python` snippets? I trimmed curl earlier

sam: I'd keep both for now; curl helps ops folks. Maybe keep curl in a collapsed block

maria: Good call. I'll add collapsed curl snippet and inline python example

tara: ETA for wording review: ~2 hours

maria: If anyone is blocked by the CI error DM me — I'll try to repro on my M1 machine

kevin: thx

sam: LGTM on the docs changes in my view :thumbsup:
